$$
\int \frac{1}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "129dd18f-6700-5ffb-9ca8-25a04326a78f" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|4 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{1}{4}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{1}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{1}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "129dd18f-6700-5ffb-9ca8-25a04326a78f" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "129dd18f-6700-5ffb-9ca8-25a04326a78f" :question/answer-fields "3db76bd0-786f-52f1-ae29-26420c6d4c60"] [:db/ensure "129dd18f-6700-5ffb-9ca8-25a04326a78f" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064250 :knowledge-point/questions "129dd18f-6700-5ffb-9ca8-25a04326a78f"] [:db/add "a979c3cc-5cec-59fa-9c86-1af8788026cf" :answer/id #uuid "a979c3cc-5cec-59fa-9c86-1af8788026cf"] [:db/add "a979c3cc-5cec-59fa-9c86-1af8788026cf" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "a979c3cc-5cec-59fa-9c86-1af8788026cf" :answer/value "\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - "42e86bff-6aba-589f-8a54-c26a0ba84936" :question/id #uuid "42e86bff-6aba-589f-8a54-c26a0ba84936"] [:db/add "42e86bff-6aba-589f-8a54-c26a0ba84936" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "42e86bff-6aba-589f-8a54-c26a0ba84936" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|5 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{4}{5}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{4}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{4}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{4}{5}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{4}{5}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "42e86bff-6aba-589f-8a54-c26a0ba84936" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "42e86bff-6aba-589f-8a54-c26a0ba84936" :question/answer-fields \int \frac{3}{|3 x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x

$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(3 x \right)}+C.

"69248dc5-2b73-53df-a95f-0df952ca5485" :question/id #uuid "69248dc5-2b73-53df-a95f-0df952ca5485"] [:db/add "69248dc5-2b73-53df-a95f-0df952ca5485" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "69248dc5-2b73-53df-a95f-0df952ca5485" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|4 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{1}{2}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "69248dc5-2b73-53df-a95f-0df952ca5485" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "69248dc5-2b73-53df-a95f-0df952ca5485" :question/answer-fields "f054d58c-180c-591b-ad06-4546c86b706b" :question/id #uuid "f054d58c-180c-591b-ad06-4546c86b706b"] [:db/add "f054d58c-180c-591b-ad06-4546c86b706b" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

\int \frac{3}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x

$$
\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{3}{4}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.

"bfa0ba88-cd1a-5014-a502-27b6d9f6c943" :question/id #uuid "bfa0ba88-cd1a-5014-a502-27b6d9f6c943"] [:db/add "bfa0ba88-cd1a-5014-a502-27b6d9f6c943" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "bfa0ba88-cd1a-5014-a502-27b6d9f6c943" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Because $3>0$, $|u|=3|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/3$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $6\cdot \frac{1}{3}=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

"2c09025a-e36a-5f98-8a3a-ecae05ef8ee0" :question/id #uuid "2c09025a-e36a-5f98-8a3a-ecae05ef8ee0"] [:db/add "2c09025a-e36a-5f98-8a3a-ecae05ef8ee0" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "2c09025a-e36a-5f98-8a3a-ecae05ef8ee0" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Because $4>0$, $|u|=4|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/4$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $12\cdot \frac{1}{4}=3$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
3\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "2c09025a-e36a-5f98-8a3a-ecae05ef8ee0" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "2c09025a-e36a-5f98-8a3a-ecae05ef8ee0" :question/answer-fields "a18b62e4-bd0f-5ad5-a4da-6ae883771ad9" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "a18b62e4-bd0f-5ad5-a4da-6ae883771ad9" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Because $2>0$, $|u|=2|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/2$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{2}=1$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(2 x \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "a18b62e4-bd0f-5ad5-a4da-6ae883771ad9" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "a18b62e4-bd0f-5ad5-a4da-6ae883771ad9" :question/answer-fields \int \frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x

Because $5>0$, $|u|=5|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/5$.

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$

"f054d58c-180c-591b-ad06-4546c86b706b" :question/id #uuid "f054d58c-180c-591b-ad06-4546c86b706b"] [:db/add "f054d58c-180c-591b-ad06-4546c86b706b" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "f054d58c-180c-591b-ad06-4546c86b706b" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|4 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{3}{4}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{3}{4}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{3}{4}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "f054d58c-180c-591b-ad06-4546c86b706b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "f054d58c-180c-591b-ad06-4546c86b706b" :question/answer-fields "bfa0ba88-cd1a-5014-a502-27b6d9f6c943" :question/id #uuid "bfa0ba88-cd1a-5014-a502-27b6d9f6c943"] [:db/add "bfa0ba88-cd1a-5014-a502-27b6d9f6c943" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "bfa0ba88-cd1a-5014-a502-27b6d9f6c943" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Because $3>0$, $|u|=3|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/3$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $6\cdot \frac{1}{3}=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(3 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "bfa0ba88-cd1a-5014-a502-27b6d9f6c943" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "bfa0ba88-cd1a-5014-a502-27b6d9f6c943" :question/answer-fields $$

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

Because $3>0$, $|u|=3|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/3$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $12\cdot \frac{1}{3}=4$.

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$

$$"] [:db/add "e0ca915f-85de-5d80-bc7b-4f29aece6b54" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "e0ca915f-85de-5d80-bc7b-4f29aece6b54" :question/answer-fields ["f1b7fa87-c039-55a3-9a9e-c5ff3a8013fa" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] ["f1b7fa87-c039-55a3-9a9e-c5ff3a8013fa" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|5 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{3}{5}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{3}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{3}{5}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{3}{5}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] ["f1b7fa87-c039-55a3-9a9e-c5ff3a8013fa" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] ["f1b7fa87-c039-55a3-9a9e-c5ff3a8013fa" :question/answer-fields "4d199d5d-0de4-57e8-9e25-af029988c010"] Because $4>0$, $|u|=4|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/4$.

$$

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

"Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] ["e0ca915f-85de-5d80-bc7b-4f29aece6b54" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Because $3>0$, $|u|=3|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/3$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $12\cdot \frac{1}{3}=4$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(3 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] ["e0ca915f-85de-5d80-bc7b-4f29aece6b54" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] ["e0ca915f-85de-5d80-bc7b-4f29aece6b54" :question/answer-fields "4e83d6e8-b921-5001-9022-b4bf4f708392"] [17592186064250 :knowledge-point/questions "e0ca915f-85de-5d80-bc7b-4f29aece6b54"] ["generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "81715594-f2a8-545e-be47-73da10178012"] ["generator" :question-generator/script "generators/05/0599fdcb3992b68a8349452a729dc6f86888dab8bf8590d92c455eec38d3bfdc/generator.py"] [17592186064250 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] [17592186676884 :question/retired true] [17592186676889 :question/retired true] [17592186676900 :question/retired true] [17592186676901 :question/retired true] [17592186676905 :question/retired true] [17592186676917 :question/retired true] [17592186676920 :question/retired true] [17592186676931 :question/retired true] [17592186676949 :question/retired true] [17592186676960 :question/retired true] [17592186676964 :question/retired true] [17592186676965 :question/retired true] [17592186676967 :question/retired true] [17592186676971 :question/retired true] [17592186676973 :question/retired true] [17592186676976 :question/retired true] [17592186676979 :question/retired true] [17592186676982 :question/retired true] [17592186676986 :question/retired true] [17592186676997 :question/retired true] [17592186677001 :question/retired true] [17592186677008 :question/retired true] [17592186677022 :question/retired true] [17592186677040 :question/retired true]] "retractions" [[17592186064250 :knowledge-point/question-generator 17592186677041]]}
